title: AI POD credential reference shape
description: Inventory YAML never holds secret values; it holds *_pass_ref keys naming an environment variable (Phase 1) or a vault path (Phase 2). All access goes through shared/lib/secrets.py::resolve() so backends can be swapped without touching call sites. See codeguard-1-hardcoded-credentials workspace rule.

secret_ref.description:
Reference to a secret value. Supported forms:
  env:VAR_NAME      Phase 1 env var (explicit prefix)
  VAR_NAME          Phase 1 env var (shorthand, must be UPPER_SNAKE)
  vault:path#field  Phase 2 vault backend
  file:/abs/path    Phase 2 file backend

username.description: Username (admin, oper, svc-...). No whitespace; no shell metacharacters.

credential.description: A username + secret-reference pair. Use this shape anywhere a service needs both.
